paper: Alpha-R1: Alpha Screening with LLM Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
headline_strategy: A GRPO-trained Qwen3-8B reasoning model semantically gates factors from a retained Alpha101 zoo using factor profiles, weekly market memory and daily price/news state; fixed four-year regression betas score stocks, and equal-weight top-10 selections are traded through five rotating daily slots.
headline_selection_basis: The framework, methodology and main experiment identify the trained context-conditioned semantic gate—not an individual factor, Lasso, IC momentum, or the base Qwen model—as Alpha-R1's proposed strategy.
missing_headline_objects: the identities and exact implementations of the 82 retained Alpha101 factors
the historically selected fixed 40-factor test set and selection tie/missing rules
all four-year beta coefficients and intercept plus estimator/target conventions
weekly memory inputs, prompts, model calls and final global memory
factor semantic profiles, performance vectors, prompts, model calls and schema
daily price/news descriptions, state prompts, raw-to-text models and outputs
the Alpha-R1 input prompt, output schema, trained checkpoint and tokenizer revision
judge model/prompt/rubric plus structural-penalty formula and weights
GRPO group size, optimizer, learning rate, batches, epochs, epsilon, KL beta and seeds
point-in-time memberships, market/news/macro data, calendars and adjustment rules
per-run factor selections, scores, actions, VWAP fills, holdings, returns and NAVs
baseline implementations, metric definitions, aggregation order and result arrays

release_evidence.readme_status: inference code and model weights Coming Soon

release_claim_conflict: The paper states that the full implementation and resources are available at the official repository, while the repository contains one README and marks inference code and model weights Coming Soon.

rejected_substitutes.route: Use the previous quality/profitability/momentum/low-risk JKP score
rejected_substitutes.reason: Its factors and signs are a researcher-created narrative motif; none is selected by Alpha-R1's semantic gate.

rejected_substitutes.route: Use the paper's Lasso or IC-Momentum gate
rejected_substitutes.reason: They are comparison baselines, the 40-factor set is absent, and both are operationally underdefined.

rejected_substitutes.route: Train a new gate from public Alpha101 implementations
rejected_substitutes.reason: The paper's factor identities/conventions, betas, states, profiles, prompts, reward, GRPO settings and data are missing; this would create a new policy.
The ablation identifies the unaligned base model as a distinct losing baseline rather than Alpha-R1.

rejected_substitutes.route: Infer selections or paths from heatmaps/NAV rasters
rejected_substitutes.reason: Aggregate images do not identify daily factor gates, stock scores, holdings, fills or per-run paths.

result_policy: No thematic proxy, heuristic baseline, independently trained gate, base model, or raster-inferred path is entered as an Alpha-R1 monthly return. Reopen when the promised inference code, model and factor artifacts are released.
